description: This file contains assertion utility functions for testing in Lua, including custom assert functions, counters for assertions, and a test runner that executes test cases and reports success/failure counts.

methods.name: assert
methods.description: Checks if two values are equal, increments success counter on success, and prints traceback on failure if verbose is enabled.

methods.name: nassert
methods.description: Checks if two values are not equal, with verbose output on failure.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Runs a test case, reports assertion success/failure counts, and returns a boolean indicating test success.
